reasons.D: Closest sentence movement: short flat declaratives and verbless fragments ('Worms everywhere.' 'Not dripping.'), plain, unhedged, no contractions, and a dry understated line on the neighbour, much as the passage does it.
reasons.A: Similar clipped rhythm and flat tone with fragments, but small touches of personification ('starts to sulk') and a closing image rather than a dry point pull it slightly off the author's plain stance.
reasons.B: Short sentences, but a more emotional, rhetorical stance ('I will not forget the smell', 'keeps the heap alive', 'the same as we do') that the author's matter-of-fact reporting never uses.
reasons.C: Long, balanced, essayistic sentences with semicolons, abstractions and evaluative asides ('a lesson in how quickly neglect undoes'); a completely different register from the author's terse declaratives.
